description:
Planning handoff; implementation is NOT authorized in this session. Target lib/zaq/agent/actions/translate_knowledge_query.ex lines 53, 93, 94, 97, 106. No overlap with existing zaq-5vh eight-file coverage workflow (different targets). Single-step test-only issue, no dependency edges; intended root ready.

Functional specification / production owner: Zaq.Agent.Actions.TranslateKnowledgeQuery (moduledoc: internal validated operation for multilingual semantic/lexical query preparation, not exposed as an agent tool). Public execution via Jido.Exec.run/3. On failed generation, retain only requested simple query, and report every distinct requested non-simple language as an error in sorted order. On invalid provider output, fail closed in the same way; never emit malformed translated queries. Do not alter production behavior or Registry.

Files: ADD test/zaq/agent/actions/translate_knowledge_query_failure_test.exs, preserve existing test/zaq/agent/actions/translate_knowledge_query_test.exs and test/zaq/agent/tools/search_knowledge_base_test.exs. Start new ExUnit.Case async: true; no DataCase, DB, seeded system config, global env or live HTTP. Build context %{llm_config: OpenAIStub.llm_config("http://example.test/v1") |> Map.new(), generation: local_test_generator}. Reuse OpenAIStub.llm_config/1, Jido.Exec.run/3, and ReqLLM.Response/Context construction as in test/zaq/agent/tools/search_knowledge_base_test.exs FrenchGeneration.response/1. Define tiny test-local deterministic generator implementations of generate_text/3: error returns {:error, :provider_unavailable}; empty returns {:ok, valid ReqLLM.Response with assistant text only whitespace}; exception raises RuntimeError; invalid JSON returns response with malformed JSON; non-map JSON returns response with [] if desired. These modules replace only the external LLM generation boundary, not Action, ProviderSpec or decode. Reuse one test-local response helper if necessary; avoid unnecessary global Mox/server/process setup and no sleeps.

Tests to add before implementation (no production implementation expected):
1. Provider error + simple fallback: call Jido.Exec.run(Action, %{query: "red car", lexical_terms: [" red ", "car", "red"], languages: ["french", "simple", "english", "french"]}, context using error generator). Assert exact {:ok, %{queries: %{"simple" => %{semantic_query: "red car", lexical_terms: ["red", "car"]}}, errors: ["english", "french"]}}. Covers line 93 error tuple and line 53 fallback, including deduplicated/sorted languages and no untranslated non-simple query.
2. Whitespace-only generation: valid response text "  \n  "; request only ["french"]. Assert exact {:ok, %{queries: %{}, errors: ["french"]}}. Covers line 94 empty_generation branch and line 53 fallback; no translation emitted.
3. Generation exception: generator raises RuntimeError; request ["simple", "french"]. Assert exact success map containing unchanged simple query and errors ["french"] (do not assert private rescued exception internals). Covers line 97 rescue and line 53; call must not crash.
4. Invalid JSON: response assistant text "{not-json"; request ["simple", "french"]. Assert exact simple query + errors ["french"]. Covers line 106 decode failure and line 53; rejects garbled response. Optionally separate JSON-array response "[]" test to confirm non-object is equally rejected by line 106; keep only if useful beyond malformed JSON.
Each test uses a real validated Action invocation, explicit immutable inputs, exact public result; when useful include a negative assertion that no french or english key is present (already implied by exact map).

Branches and tests already preserved: successful multilingual translation, missing/invalid per-language keys, schema errors, simple-only no provider call, >8 lexical terms, simple first-occurrence property in existing action tests. New cases are concrete boundary/error variants, not a new broad invariant; property test already covers simple lexical preservation. No extra property or E2E is warranted for test-only branch coverage: no feature journey/UI changed. No required docs changes; do not weaken assertions. No permission identity or BO boundary is changed.

Action reuse assessment: no executable operation is added/changed; tests reuse existing internal Action TranslateKnowledgeQuery through Jido.Exec.run/3, ProviderSpec remains real, and SearchKnowledgeBase remains the consumer. Action is intentionally not in Tools.Registry; no new Action, helper in production, workflow node, or agent tool exposure. Existing action/consumer test contracts remain intact.

Later executor verification, NOT this planning session: run isolated mix test test/zaq/agent/actions/translate_knowledge_query_failure_test.exs, then applicable issue-level mix q and final validation lifecycle under docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md when authorized. Coverage reporting belongs to later coverage gate; do not run full suite/coverage/quality gates now. Completion means four scenarios pass through real public Action with deterministic generator and unchanged existing tests.

comments.text: Implemented the four approved failure-path scenarios in test/zaq/agent/actions/translate_knowledge_query_failure_test.exs: provider error with simple fallback and sorted/deduplicated errors; whitespace-only generation; rescued generation exception; malformed JSON rejection. Used async ExUnit with test-local deterministic generators and OpenAIStub config. Per coordinator instruction, no tests/format/quality validation run; awaiting authorization for isolated validation.
